name: Jev Compaction
description: Verbatim context compaction for OpenClaw: TypeSafe Jev scores every tool call and result in one fast request, stale ones are dropped, everything kept stays word for word.

apiKey.label: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.help: TypeSafe API key for Jev. Leave unset to use the TYPESAFE_API_KEY environment variable.

keepThreshold.label: Keep threshold (both)
keepThreshold.help: Sets both thresholds below when they are not given.

preserveRecentMessages.label: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.help: Newest messages never touched by compaction; the first message is always kept.

compactAtPercent.label: Compact at (% of context)
compactAtPercent.help: Estimated context usage at which the engine asks Jev what to drop.

minReductionRatio.label: Minimum reduction
minReductionRatio.help: A Jev pass that frees less than this fraction while the session is still over budget hands over to the fallback.

fallback.label: Fallback
fallback.help: What to do when verbatim compaction cannot get the session under budget: summarize with OpenClaw's built-in compaction, or none.

maxStateTokens.label: Maximum Jev state tokens
maxStateTokens.help: Estimated token budget for the conversation state sent with every Jev request.

maxRequestTokens.label: Maximum Jev request tokens
maxRequestTokens.help: Estimated token budget for state plus questions in one Jev request (Jev allows 64k per request; the state plus one question is always kept under 32k).

truncateHeadChars.label: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.help: Characters of a tool result kept when Jev decides its full output is no longer needed.

stateDir.label: State directory
stateDir.help: Where per-session decision files are kept. Defaults to jev-compaction/ under the agent directory.

resultPeekChars.label: Result excerpt
resultPeekChars.help: Characters from the start and from the end of each tool result shown to Jev so it can judge the content; 0 shows only the size.

maxConcurrentRequests.label: Concurrent Jev requests
maxConcurrentRequests.help: Jev requests in flight at once during one compaction pass.

timeoutMs.label: Jev request timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.help: Deadline for one Jev request, response body included.

protectTools.label: Protected tools
protectTools.help: Tools whose calls and results are always kept because they cannot be re-run. Replaces the default list (Agent, Task, AskUserQuestion, sessions_spawn, sessions_send, subagents, message).

editTools.label: Edit tools
editTools.help: Tools that change files; their calls are always kept, as is the newest read of a file edited afterwards. Replaces the default list (Edit, Write, MultiEdit, NotebookEdit, edit, write, apply_patch).

keepCallThreshold.label: Keep call threshold
keepCallThreshold.help: Minimum Jev probability (0–1) for a tool call to stay.

keepResultThreshold.label: Keep result threshold
keepResultThreshold.help: Minimum Jev probability (0–1) for a tool result to stay verbatim. Result scores run lower than call scores, so this default is lower.

questionStyle.label: Question style
questionStyle.help: useful asks whether a call or output still serves the task (recommended); recoverable is the original wording that asks whether re-running the tool would not do.

retries.label: Retries
retries.help: Retries per Jev request on a rate limit, server error or transport failure.
